**Rotate refresh token and get new access token**

Exchanges a refresh token for a NEW access token AND a NEW refresh token. The old refresh token is revoked and cannot be used again (token rotation).

**Important:** The NEW refreshToken returned in the response must be stored and used for subsequent refresh requests.

**Token Rotation Flow:**
1. Client sends old refresh token
2. Server validates token (not revoked, not expired, user active)
3. Server revokes old token (marks rotatedAt)
4. Server issues new refresh token (valid for 7 days)
5. Server issues new access token (valid for 15 minutes)
6. Client must update stored refreshToken with new value

**Security Benefits:**
- Each refresh token can only be used once
- Stolen tokens expire quickly when rotated
- Sessions continue indefinitely while user active

**Error Codes:**
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REQUIRED` (400): No token provided
- `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN` (401): Token not found or malformed
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REVOKED` (401): Token already used/revoked
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED` (401): Token expired (7 days)
- `USER_DELETED` (403): Account deactivated
- `REFRESH_FAILED` (500): Server error

Create a new private anamnesis (questionnaire) with optional nested sections, questions, and options. Always creates with isGeneral: false.
List all anamneses visible to the trainer: their own private ones + all general (platform) anamneses.
Get full nested detail (sections, questions, options) of an anamnesis. Accessible if it is general or owned by the trainer.
Update anamnesis title/description. Blocked for general anamneses (returns 403).
Soft-delete an anamnesis with cascade to all sections and questions. Blocked for general anamneses.
Fork an anamnesis into a new version. Deep copies all non-deleted sections, questions, and options. Sets version = source.version + 1 and parentId = source.id. Blocked for general anamneses.
Add a new section to an anamnesis. Optionally include questions and options.
Reorder sections by providing section UUIDs in desired order. Each gets an order value equal to its index.
Update section title, description, or order.

Update a question. If options array is provided, it completely replaces existing options.
Soft-delete a question.
Link an anamnesis to a student. Trainer must own the student relationship and have access to the anamnesis (own it or it is general). Returns 409 if already linked.
List all anamneses linked to a student by this trainer.
Remove the link between an anamnesis and a student (hard delete of the junction record).

Get a student's response to a specific anamnesis. Trainer must own the trainer-student relationship and have linked the anamnesis to the student. Returns 404 if the student has not submitted a response yet.
Get all anamneses linked to the authenticated student. Returns full nested detail including sections, questions, options, and trainer info.

Submit or re-submit a response to an anamnesis. All required questions must be answered. Subsequent submissions fully replace all previous answers. The anamnesis must be linked to the student's account.
Get the authenticated student's previously submitted response to an anamnesis, including all answers. Returns 404 if not linked or not yet submitted.
Create a new public anamnesis (isGeneral: true, trainerId: null) with optional nested sections and questions. Requires ADMIN role. Admins can edit public anamneses even when linked to students.
List all public (isGeneral: true) anamneses. Includes sections summary (id, title, order) for each. Requires ADMIN role.
Get full nested detail (sections, questions, options) of a public anamnesis. Returns 404 if not found, deleted, or not public. Requires ADMIN role.
Update title and/or description of a public anamnesis. No student-link guard — admins can edit freely. Requires ADMIN role.
Soft-delete a public anamnesis. Cascades to sections and questions (sets deletedAt). Requires ADMIN role.
Add a section (with optional nested questions) to a public anamnesis. No student-link guard. Requires ADMIN role.
Reorder sections in a public anamnesis by providing an array of section UUIDs in the desired order. Requires ADMIN role.
Update title, description, or order of a section in a public anamnesis. Requires ADMIN role.
Soft-delete a section in a public anamnesis. Cascades to all questions in that section. Requires ADMIN role.

item.name: Add Question to Public Anamnesis Section

request.description: Add a question (with optional options) to a section on a public anamnesis. Requires ADMIN role.
Update a question on a public anamnesis. If options are provided they completely replace existing options. Requires ADMIN role.
Soft-delete a question on a public anamnesis (sets deletedAt). Requires ADMIN role.

Copy an anamnesis into a new independent private copy owned by the trainer. Works for public anamneses (isGeneral: true) or the trainer's own private anamneses. The copy starts fresh: parentId: null, version: 1, isGeneral: false. Unlike fork (which creates a new version of your own anamnesis), copy creates a completely new independent record. Requires TRAINER role.

Accepts a PrimeCoaching active customers XLSX export uploaded as multipart/form-data, parses it, and returns a preview student list. Nothing is saved to the Treinoway database.

Requires TRAINER role. Rate limited: 3 requests/minute.

response.name: Preview PrimeCoaching Students - 400 Format Changed

request.description:
Send a message to the AI training assistant. The assistant can create and manage protocols, trainings, and exercises on behalf of the trainer.

Requires TRAINER role. Rate limited: 10 requests/minute.

The `historySignature` field is an HMAC returned by the server in each response — pass it back with subsequent turns to allow the server to verify the conversation history has not been tampered with.

Confirmation turn in a multi-turn conversation. The trainer confirms a pending action proposed by the assistant in the previous turn.

The `conversationHistory` must contain the prior turns, and the `historySignature` must match the value returned by the server at the end of the previous turn — otherwise the request is rejected with 400.

Requires TRAINER role. Rate limited: 10 requests/minute.
